Zelenskyy seeks NATO membership for Ukraine's security

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that NATO membership is the clearest security guarantee for Ukraine, and he is seeking long-lasting solutions. Reports indicate the Ukraine war is extending into NATO territory.
